依角和邊的條件判斷圖形，不靠擺放方向猜。: Classify shapes by angles and sides, rather than by orientation.

放大一個公分，逐格指數 10 個間隔；再回到整段長度。螢幕尺寸不當作實際公分。: Enlarge one centimeter and count its 10 intervals. Then return to the whole length. On-screen dimensions do not establish actual centimeters.

能否固定圓心、保持半徑，並用兩條半徑解釋直徑。: Can the student fix the center, keep the radius constant, and explain the diameter using two radii?
能否指出每組數量、組數，將分組圖和乘法算式互相對應。: Can the student identify the amount per group and the number of groups, connecting the grouping picture to multiplication?
能否指出直角及邊長證據，並在圖形旋轉後維持判斷。: Can the student point to evidence about right angles and side lengths and keep the same classification after rotation?

能否對齊位值、記下交換後的數量，並用相反運算檢查。: Can the student align place values, record exchanged amounts, and check using the inverse operation?
能否確認等分、指出分母與分子，並比較同分母分數。: Can the student verify equal parts, identify numerator and denominator, and compare fractions with the same denominator?
能否讀對刻度、說出單位關係，並把混合單位改為毫升。: Can the student read the scale, explain the unit relationship, and convert mixed units to milliliters?
將 2 公升 300 毫升改為毫升，再與 2000 毫升比較。: Convert 2 L 300 mL to milliliters, then compare it with 2000 mL.
